welcome.title: 🎮 *Welcome to Epic Games Free Bot!*
welcome.description: I will notify you when there are new free games on the Epic Games Store.
welcome.commands:
📋 *Available commands:*
/start - Show this message
/subscribe - Subscribe to notifications
/unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications
/check - Check free games now
/help - Show help

help.title: 🤖 *Help - Epic Games Free Bot*
help.commands:
📋 *Available commands:*
• /start - Start the bot and show welcome
• /subscribe - Subscribe to free game notifications
• /unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications
• /check - Check free games immediately
• /help - Show this help message
help.schedule:
⏰ *When you will receive notifications:*
The bot automatically checks for new free games every day at 18:00.
help.info:
ℹ️ *Information:*
- The bot monitors the Epic Games Store
- You will receive notifications only for new free games
- You can unsubscribe anytime with /unsubscribe

subscribedUser: ✅ You are now subscribed to free game notifications!
unsubscribedUser: ❌ You have unsubscribed from notifications. You will no longer receive alerts about free games. Use /subscribe to reactivate.
subscribedGroup: ✅ The group "{title}" is now subscribed to notifications!
unsubscribedGroup: ❌ The group "{title}" has been unsubscribed from notifications.
errorGeneric: ❌ An error occurred. Please try again later.
errorCheckGames: ❌ I could not check the free games. Please try again later.
errorNoFreeGames: 😔 There are no free games available right now on the Epic Games Store.
checkLog: Check server logs for full details
